Definition: Joash, the name of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Joash is named twice in the Bible, and the passages here are 1 Chronicles 7:8; 1 Chronicles 27:28. In 1 Chronicles 7:8 we read, "And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth..." The same name belongs to more than one man, and 1 Chronicles 27:28 names another of them.
TheologicalSignificance: Joash is brief in Scripture and long in God's memory, and that is my conviction. A name like this one reminds me that God forgets no one.
RelatedPeople: Joash, Son of Becher; Joash, Steward of Oil
